violation_type.title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201(a))
violation_type.short_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegations and found to be deficient. It was observed by licensing during an inspection in the school age classroom, an outdated lesson plan was posted.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegations and found to be deficient. It was observed by licensing during an inspection in the school age classroom, an outdated lesson plan was posted.
Current activity plan for toddler class was not available for review.  The activty plan posted for the class was for week of August 29th-September 2nd, 2022.
There were no planned activites in the toddler room.

Mutiple classrooms did not have currently lesson plans for their classrooms. Some classrooms had lessons for the week of 4/4-4/8 and no current lesson plans. This was corrected when lesson plans were printed and taken to each classroom.

Operation does not have written lesson plans. Daily schedule for all ages indicates children have the choice of education or video movie 7-8am and 5-5:30 PM. Daily schedule does not indicate when physical activity takes place. Infant-age children have not been participating in outdoor play.
